title: Integrate first wave + actual small chronology
head: 4506a2e9a89dfeccacb0ef23fcbfe094e4eb9a36

environment.host: PACE login-class node, 4-core cgroup, loadavg 17.7-20.3 during runs (co-tenant CPU contention; wall times are not performance claims)
environment.env_hygiene: run24/run48/multitile assert empty SOLWEIG_LIGHT_* at process start; recorded solweig_env_at_start: {} in every mode output; oracle48 sets its two kill-switch env vars programmatically

run_A_default.claim: The pure default path (no env, no runtime options) admits and completes the 24-step landcover golden tile at this HEAD on this host: job estimate 809,673,344 B vs resolved default budget view 2,744,623,104 B (4% of the container-correct 68,719,476,736 B view; S03b). The S03b host-demo refusal was a larger-estimate scenario; the default outcome is estimate-dependent, not a fixed host verdict.
run_A_default.note: Default options on this host: workers=1, threads_per_worker=1, cpu_budget=1. run24 pins exactly this execution config.

run_B_run24.config: workers=1, threads_per_worker=1, cpu_budget=1, memory_budget_bytes=5.5e9 (explicit budget = only deviation)
run_B_run24.determinism_note: Two independent run24 executions (03:5x) produced identical per-file worst max_abs and coordinates (compare24 re-verified the second execution from disk).

run_C_run48_oracle48.chronology: 48 half-hourly steps: disclosed extension of the real golden metfile (each hourly row duplicated at imin=30, identical forcing); 48 rows are the chronology (pipeline.py:104 loadtxt, no date filter); timestepdec becomes 0.5 h

candidate.routes: all accepted S10 routes at defaults (T01 primary, G01/G02 prepared GVF, R03 packed aniLum)

oracle.forcing: SOLWEIG_LIGHT_ANILUM_PACKED=0 (R03), SOLWEIG_LIGHT_GVF_PREPARE=0 (G01/G02 -> serial delegate), patch_radiation._uniform_tgwall -> decline (T01 primaries fall back to the serial reference: main's census-documented behavior; all four admission sites resolve the name from patch_radiation at call time)
oracle.engagement_interpretation: prepared=30 counts CALLS entering prepared_gvf_step (the engine wrapper calls it unconditionally); with the toggle off all 30 delegated to the serial route (serial=30 vs candidate serial=0)

run_C_run48_oracle48.config: both sides workers=1, threads_per_worker=1, cpu_budget=1, memory_budget_bytes=5.5e9 (matched execution config)
run_C_run48_oracle48.no_stored_goldens_note: no original-CPU goldens exist for the 48-step chronology; the forced-reference full-pipeline run is the oracle (the upstream oracle environment does not exist on this host)

disclosed_deviations: memory_budget_bytes=9.6e9 (default-admissible base refused 2x4.313e9 B phase reservations; policy reject is by design)
second tile is a byte-copy of the golden tile (same-content tile)
run_D_multitile.refusal_record: first attempt with memory_budget_bytes=5.5e9 raised ResourceAdmissionError before any worker spawned: "requested 2 concurrent phase jobs but only 1 fit: the 2 largest reservations sum to 8,625,995,928 B against a 5,070,503,270 B reservation base" (C6-42 policy=reject, by design; retained in multitile_err.log)
